purpose: Integrate automatic skill acquisition, component attribution and fresh common-protocol comparison without mixing proposal, library-selection, routing-envelope and benchmark-identity units.
decision_problem: Which prospective program can support a causal automatic-acquisition claim, component-level mechanism evidence and a fair external-method comparison without pseudoreplication or post-outcome design?

A_staged_multi_unit_program.description: Use separate prospective stages for proposal-level acquisition, proposal/routing component interventions and benchmark-level common comparison, each with its own denominator and claim.
advantages: Preserves the correct statistical unit for each theoretical component.
Makes the automatic-construction claim independently falsifiable.
Allows the 38-record common cohort to provide honest size-generalization and compatibility evidence without overstating power.
Retains a publishable authored-skill fallback if automatic acquisition fails.
costs: Requires new prospective proposal and routing-envelope populations.
Cannot claim an empirical MDL effect unless independent library-selection episodes are created.
Needs more than the existing 38 benchmark identities for a broad superiority claim.

B_single_38_record_factorial.description: Run Base, static, full and all component removals on the 38 fresh RCPSP/VRPTW identities and use one table as the entire causal story.
rejection_reasons: Benchmark identities are not independent skill-proposal or library-selection units.
Known-family records do not contain zero- or multiple-guard opportunities, so routing is not identified.
The cohort has only 12.09 percent power under the illustrative moderate Holm-planning case.
The design would create pseudoreplication and unsupported necessity claims.

C_authored_skill_only_submission.description: Stop the automatic-construction claim and submit the current authored proof-carrying skills, theory and bounded external audit as the final method story.
advantages: Already supported by strong TSP and OR-Debug endpoint gains.
Avoids overstating the negative automatic proposer trace.
costs: Leaves the main knowledge-evolution mechanism unvalidated.
Weakens novelty relative to a top-conference automatic knowledge-engineering claim.
Does not close the fresh common-protocol comparison.
C_authored_skill_only_submission.fallback_condition: Use only if the prospective acquisition study fails or cannot produce a valid independent proposal population.

objects: atomic fact ledger and immutable fact IDs
typed grammar, semantic oracle and exact resource checker
request, token, output and retry ceilings
custody, randomization, missingness and stop rules
stage_0_common_freeze.rule: No treatment payload or model request is created before all shared objects are content-addressed.

stage_1_acquisition_canary.unit: One rejected typed proposal plus its frozen version-space state and parent lineage.
stage_1_acquisition_canary.population: Eight outcome-independent units; existing model proposal identities remain distinct from deterministically selected synthetic repair seeds, which must be labelled synthetic.

arms.flat: Canonical sequence of the same atomic fact IDs without partition structure.
arms.separating_witness: The same fact IDs plus verifier-derived outcome partitions; no winner, winner hash, minimum repair or endpoint label.

stage_1_acquisition_canary.teacher: At each round select the eligible witness minimizing the largest remaining verifier-outcome cell, with lexicographic SHA-256 tie breaking.
stage_1_acquisition_canary.matched_budget: Same model, schema, maximum rounds, output ceiling, retry rule and reserved-token ceiling; interleave paired cells in frozen hash order.
stage_1_acquisition_canary.primary_outcome: Verifier-valid and resource-valid skill admitted within the common budget.
stage_1_acquisition_canary.progression_gate: Engineering-only: at least two net paired treatment wins, zero control-only wins and no global safety failure. This gate is not a significance result.

stage_2_acquisition_confirmation.population: A new, independently frozen proposal-level population that excludes the eight canary units and their descendant lineages.
stage_2_acquisition_confirmation.planning_case: One-sided alpha .05, discordance r=.30 and treatment-win probability q=.70 among discordant pairs gives at least 80 percent exact power.
stage_2_acquisition_confirmation.analysis: Full-denominator paired difference, discordant counts, exact one-sided paired test and confidence interval; every unavailable or invalid cell remains in the denominator under the frozen missingness rule.
stage_2_acquisition_confirmation.claim_if_positive: Separating-witness organization improves automatic acquisition under the frozen grammar, verifier, model and budget.
stage_2_acquisition_confirmation.claim_if_negative: The automatic acquisition hypothesis is rejected or remains unsupported; retain the result and use the authored-skill fallback story.

stage_3_component_program.semantic_and_resource: Use one prospective content-addressed candidate pool with paired offline outcomes. Remove only the method-level semantic or predictive resource gate; immutable outer parser, compiler and hard safety caps remain.
stage_3_component_program.routing: Use a separate answer-free envelope population with prespecified zero, unique and multiple matches plus paraphrase, schema-shift and new-family cases. Compare exactly-one fallback with a frozen forced or relaxed policy.
stage_3_component_program.complexity: Estimate an empirical effect only if independent common-pool library-selection episodes can be generated. Otherwise retain MDL/prefix-code control as a theoretical design principle and do not claim causal necessity.
stage_3_component_program.multiplicity: Use Holm familywise alpha .05 across confirmatory component contrasts. Under the illustrative r=.30,q=.70 four-contrast planning case, target at least 205 valid units for 80 percent power or label the analysis exploratory.
stage_3_component_program.safety: Unsafe candidates are scored only by isolated offline evaluators and can never be promoted or execute without immutable caps.

stage_4_fresh_common_protocol.cohort: The 38 outcome-blind larger RCPSP/VRPTW identities already bound by the estimand audit.
stage_4_fresh_common_protocol.primary_view: Answer-blind common evidence with AntChat DeepSeek-V4-Flash and method-native budgets.
separate_views: BIND answer-bearing final outside the primary table
stage_4_fresh_common_protocol.interpretation: Size-generalization, compatibility and mechanism confirmation; not a broad superiority leaderboard unless a larger independent cohort or source-lineage replication is added.

paper_claim_ladder: Authored proof-carrying skills improve formulation accuracy on two frozen benchmark sources.
A positive Stage 2 would add a causal claim that separating-witness organization improves automatic typed-skill acquisition under a fixed budget.
Positive component studies would support only the components with valid units and Holm-controlled outcomes; untested MDL remains a design principle.
Stage 4 adds prospective common-protocol breadth and external-method compatibility, with its N=38 power boundary disclosed.
No stage proves universal language understanding, unrestricted RSI or distribution-free non-regression.

implementation_gate.approval_statement: 批准方案A作为G07–G09前瞻实验的整体架构。
implementation_gate.staging_rule: Implement and freeze each stage separately; API, solver and native execution remain bounded by that stage's content-addressed plan, safety caps and terminal accounting.
still_prohibited: unsafe candidate execution outside immutable parser, compiler and resource caps
outcome-driven cohort replacement or favorable reruns
